messages:
support_jen: customer reported a 500 from /v1/rerank when sending a batch of 12 candidates, says it worked yesterday and started failing after a deploy. attaching their curl and response.

support_jen: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query": "best laptop for travel", "candidates": ["lightweight laptop", "gaming laptop", "business ultrabook", "budget chromebook", "2-in-1 convertible", "workstation laptop", "refurbished laptop", "student laptop", "macbook pro", "macbook air", "linux laptop", "tablet"]}'

support_jen: response: 500 Internal Server Error {"error":"AssertionError: candidate_emb.shape[1] == query_emb.shape[0] failed", "request_id":"req_20240318_5f3a2b"}

devon: thanks, can we get the exact request_id from their headers? req_20240318_5f3a2b looks like the client id but need server trace id (X-Redwood-Req). also want the model they were using for embeddings + rerank.

support_jen: customer pasted X-Redwood-Req: 6b9f1a7c-8d2e-4b6c-b213-9f4d8fb211aa and says they used model "embed-lite-1" on their side and called /v1/rerank with default model on server side (auto).

rahul: quick hypothesis: mismatch between embedding dimension from embed-lite-1 (1280) vs rerank expected 1536. need server logs for that trace id. @srebot can you pull logs for 6b9f1a7c-8d2e-4b6c-b213-9f4d8fb211aa?

srebot: log bundle for trace 6b9f1a7c-8d2e-4b6c-b213-9f4d8fb211aa created: /var/rdw/debug/6b9f1a7c-8d2e-4b6c-b213-9f4d8fb211aa.tar.gz (expires in 48h). includes proxy, api-server, rerank-worker logs and the model adapter traces.

emma: pasted relevant rerank-worker snippet from logs:

```
2025-03-18T14:12:03.421Z ERROR rerank_worker.py:142 AssertionError: candidate_emb.shape[1] == query_emb.shape[0]
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "./rerank_worker.py", line 140, in score_batch
    assert candidate_emb.shape[1] == query_emb.shape[0]
AssertionError
  File "./model_adapters/embed_adapter.py", line 58, in embed
    return np.array(embeddings)  # shape (n, 1280)
```

emma: looks like query emb is 1536 and candidate emb is 1280, reversed from what rahul suggested. need to know which model produced which dim. server side was using "standard-rerank-v1" which expects 1536.

ops_anna: customer-side repro bundle would help. request them to run a minimal curl that returns both raw embedding vectors and the rerank call. ask them to run these two steps and paste outputs. include header X-Redwood-Debug: 1 so we get server-side correlation ids.

ops_anna: example curl to fetch embeddings for each text (single call):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"embed-lite-1","input":["lightweight laptop","gaming laptop"]}'
```

ops_anna: and rerank run with explicit embeddings payload (to isolate the rerank path):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'X-Redwood-Debug: 1' \
  -d '{"query_embedding": [/* paste query vector here */], "candidate_embeddings": [[/* candidate1 vec */],[/* candidate2 vec */], ...] }'
```

devon: if they can't paste full vectors, ask for first 8 numbers of each vector and the vector length. e.g. "len=1280, head=[0.0012, -0.0023, ...]". That often shows mismatched providers.

support_jen: asked customer to run both commands, they sent back embedding response header: X-Redwood-Req: 6b9f1a7c-8d2e-4b6c-b213-9f4d8fb211aa and embeddings meta: {"model":"embed-lite-1","vector_len":1280}

support_jen: they also attached the rerank request server side return: X-Redwood-Req: 6b9f1a7c-8d2e-4b6c-b213-9f4d8fb211aa, rerank used model: standard-rerank-v1 meta: {"expected_vector_len":1536}

rahul: clear mismatch confirmed. likely either the client is using embed-lite-1 while server rerank is using standard-rerank-v1's encoder or the rerank pipeline auto-embed picked a different model. action items: 1) ask customer to send the exact HTTP payload for rerank (we want to confirm they didn't pass raw strings expecting server to embed) 2) we should add a defensive error message with more context (vector sizes). I'll file a quick follow-up bug to surface expected vs actual dims in the 500.

devon: meanwhile temporary workaround: they can pass explicit "query_embedding" + "candidate_embeddings" produced from the same model, or set rerank param embed_model:"embed-lite-1" so server uses 1280 path (if supported).

support_jen: customer responded: they were sending plain strings to rerank and assumed server would use the same embed model as their embed calls. they were inconsistent because they called embeddings earlier with embed-lite-1 but rerank defaulted to standard-rerank-v1 after the deploy changed default mapping.

emma: goodwill note: recommend we also add a sanity-check at the API proxy to compare auto-generated embedding dims vs model expected dims and return 400 with clear message rather than 500 assert.

srebot: created ticket INF-9123: "Improve rerank dim mismatch errors and expose model hint" and linked trace 6b9f1a7c-8d2e-4b6c-b213-9f4d8fb211aa. assigned to rahul.

rahul: I'll take INF-9123, plan: add explicit validation, log expected vs actual dims, and update docs about embed_model parameter. ETA EOD tomorrow for PR.

ops_anna: note for support playbook: always request X-Redwood-Req header, the embed model used client-side, and either full vector lengths or head/tail sample. also ask for proxy logs if they use self-hosted network appliances (we've seen gzip/content-encoding mangles causing corrupt arrays).

support_jen: customer applied the workaround to pass query_embedding/candidate_embeddings created from embed-lite-1 and rerank succeeded. closing loop with them and marking this as "resolved - mismatch". will link INF-9123 for follow-up.

devon: thumbs up. moving to triage board and adding a short KB article for support agents with the repro checklist.

support_jen: thanks team :thumbsup:
